results.title: Lithium Compounds Could be Subject to AD/CVD Duties | Sandler, Travis & Rosenberg, P.A.
results.content:
Subscribe to daily updates

Background

A petition filed March 5 could result in the imposition of antidumping and countervailing duties on imports of lithium hexafluorophosphate from China.

Scope [...] LiPF6 is typically sold as a high-purity solid salt, liquid, or as part of an electrolyte solution to produce lithium-ion batteries. Its common characteristics include minimal particulates, low moisture, trace acidic/chloride/sulfate impurities, and negligible metal contamination.

Subject merchandise is typically classifiable under HTSUS subheading 2826.90.9010 but may also be classified under subheadings 2826.90.9090, 3824.91.0000, and 3824.99.9397.

AD/CVD Duty Rates [...] Scope

Subject merchandise consists of lithium hexafluorophosphate (commonly referred to as LiPF6) in any form, including powder, crystal, diluted in solvent(s), in electrolyte formations, and mixtures where LiPF6 comprises more than five percent of the total weight of the mixture. The scope only includes the LiPF6 component of any such mixtures.

results.title: Lithium Hexafluorophosphate Market Size & Forecast, 2033
results.content:
The global lithium hexafluorophosphate market is estimated at US$1.4 billion in 2026.

The lithium hexafluorophosphate market is primarily driven by surging global electric vehicle adoption and battery gigafactory capacity expansion, alongside rapid growth in grid-scale and industrial energy storage systems that require large volumes of high-purity electrolyte salt.

The lithium hexafluorophosphate market is forecast to grow at a CAGR of 13.9% between 2026 and 2033. [...] Lithium hexafluorophosphate (LiPF6), the most widely used electrolyte salt in lithium-ion batteries, offers high ionic conductivity, excellent electrochemical stability, and strong compatibility with carbonate-based solvent systems, making it an indispensable component in modern battery electrolyte formulations.

### Key Industry Highlights: [...] India is anticipated to be the fastest-growing, with over 30% of market share within Asia Pacific, supported by the Government of India's Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for advanced chemistry cell battery manufacturing. India's developing domestic EV manufacturing ecosystem and growing battery gigafactory investment are creating new demand for electrolyte materials, though the country currently remains heavily dependent on imported LiPF6 supply from established Asian producers.
